name: prelaunch-audit-report
description: Turns repo scanners, a Row Level Security probe in PGlite, an optional read-only probe of the live Supabase project and live-URL checks into a severity-rated pre-launch audit report (JSON, HTML, PDF) with verified patch diffs, for Next.js or Vite/React + Supabase + Stripe apps. Personal project.
author: Sunnatulla E.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.sample: node src/cli.ts test/fixtures/broken-notes-app --out examples/sample-report --date 2026-11-09T09:00:00Z --note "Sample report. broken-notes-app is a small Next.js + Supabase + Stripe demo written with security holes on purpose for this repo's tests (test/fixtures/broken-notes-app). Every finding below is real tool output on that code. It is not a client project."
scripts.sample:phi: node src/cli.ts test/fixtures/clinic-intake-app --phi --skip-npm-audit --out examples/sample-report-clinic-phi --date 2026-11-16T09:00:00Z --note "Sample report. clinic-intake is a small Lovable-shaped clinic app (Vite + React, Supabase, Deno edge functions) written with health-data holes on purpose for this repo's tests (test/fixtures/clinic-intake-app). All patients and data in it are made up. Every finding below is real tool output on that code. It is not a client project."
